# Local declared transport and receipt-snapshot component evidence

Summary: Exact source3 records verified; source1/source2 failures retained. These are local component/integration results, not native qualification. Final deterministic suite: 947 passed,
0 failed, 2 ignored across 39 groups in 800.907s.
Tested source: `sha256:e908c28aada5577ce254bcf2a78e2eb5e5c5c9b8e1950b4d01bccd20ce7e9c65`. Final totals are derived only from full3; historical
and focused counts are never added to that total. Publication requires the collector to validate every required source3 result.

The transport increment extends explicitly declared IndependentReview diagnostics
through observation-only bootstrap/watchdog denial, actual matched-response
projections, and one bounded pass over the original reader's queued frames and
residual/new bytes. A dedicated post-validation event establishes the observed
thread. Early completed text remains operation-only; tentative or changed binding
cannot supply thread/turn authority. Late same-thread policy and exact interaction
holds remain denial evidence before the existing final checkpoint. Ordinary worker
opt-in, tool dispatch, source/permit gates and scorer criteria remain.

Every enabled capture remains Incomplete or a stronger failure state. Typed clean
EOF is separate diagnostic evidence about the original stdout reader; it proves
neither native process exit, descendant containment, remote effect closure nor
complete output/read/effect coverage or absence of disclosure. No native positive,
actual-agent trial, canary result or E07 behavior is claimed. Scorers, evaluation
fixtures, instructions and qualification predicates are unchanged.

The fourteen new transport tests use actual duplex/AsyncRead/parser components
with explicitly synthetic session/catalog inputs and denial-only brokers. They
cover queued frames/actual EOF; no tail dispatch or response; same-thread policy
on an unknown turn; seven late interaction methods and failed checkpoint; original
absolute deadline and single-use refusal; malformed/partial frames; wire, decoded,
residual and frame bounds; bootstrap/watchdog denial; matched-response text; failed
thread-start instruction discovery; and initial-only unbound output without later
rebinding. Extended overflow coverage checks exact records/references unchanged.
Protected readback corrupts/restores/deletes the actual agent-message payload.
Archive readback retains incomplete transport-end state; legacy absence is unknown.

Two further new tests use actual Control admission/effect/storage components.
One holds the real completion gate before the Sent-to-Acknowledged receipt
replacement, then requires the production snapshot reader to observe the exact
acknowledged receipt while an earlier owned Sent snapshot remains unchanged. The
other creates a real hard link, requires the existing unsafe_storage refusal,
removes only the alias and checks exact restored identity. Source inspection
confirms ordinary and all active reconstruction now consume one owned receipt
epoch captured under Control, with provider waits outside that gate. The final
corrective publication callback retains its existing current receipt read. These
components do not prove crash durability or complete native reconstruction.

Source inspection also confirms that the evaluator retains its exact original
authority request duration while passing the original absolute cutoff separately.
The two existing deadline components exercise owned deadline settlement, not a
native evaluator. Existing provider/worker/evaluation/report and storage/reconcile
compatibility checks preserve their original assertions. The sixteen new tests
and the two formerly failing tests must each pass once in their actual full3
target; both other affected successor/ordinary fixtures must also pass there.

## Preserved failures and corrections

Source1 all-target check passed (25.271s); strict Clippy failed (18.403s) at two
collapsible_if sites in codex_observation.rs, lines483 and945. The syntax-only
correction preserved condition operands and assertions. The before/after/diff and
both source identities remain retained. Static reviews also preserve T-1's early

findings are not invented executed test failures.

and `runtime_delivery::release::successor_fixture::chained_runtime_retains_merged_contribution_through_deployment_only_predecessor`.
The first returned unsafe_storage before the validation-retry fixture was entered;
the log did not identify the receipt leaf. The second reported
observation_unavailable / latest reconciliation did not complete without its
latched cause. Neither exact interleaving is claimed to have been observed.
Plan2 was not run; no inventory2/diff2 or finalization is inferred. The prior
source2 collector remains held and unexecuted.

Source3 addresses two concrete statically reachable interleavings: unlocked receipt
reconstruction versus legitimate protected receipt replacement, and the synthetic
two-comment origin publication versus the fixture's background native refresh.
The production correction captures one actual receipt Vec under Control. The
fixture-only correction takes the existing poll barrier, performs a real refresh
and unchanged current gate, then preserves the original publication gates and owner

Failure context now preserves effect/publication identity and health cause. This
is not a retry-until-pass, storage-check relaxation or a proven retrospective
cause assignment. Original failed logs and independent reviews are retained.

## Evidence scope

The exact recorded set is twenty invocations: two source1 records, seven source2

Five existing partial rows receive only the reviewed component appends: the four
transport report/E07 mappings and one narrow protected-receipt storage clause.
No row is promoted and prior evidence/order/status/stale history stays unchanged.
No separate reconciliation/admission, crash-durability or OS requirement pass is
claimed. Missing live, human, native-registration, provider-account and containment

# Independent broker observation review

Summary: two bounded diagnostic-correctness findings require correction before this held candidate is integrated. No material authority, dispatch, original-call identity, Control reentry or capture-budget defect was otherwise identified in this static review. Six authored tests are unrun; no compilation or native qualification is claimed.

## Exact review input

Reviewed `/private/tmp/kegari-independent-broker-observation-v1`, FILES SHA256 `c6faf5b81b99ae6c7c5ebf5caddc0f3655b8ac2cc4b671c3d8a8b18da25ef21b`, patch SHA256 `a5157010304f67db127e2d4127b78284e3bcebe2327904451f535da118a13df6`. All fifteen drafts and thirteen bases matched the supplied hashes. Reviewed the complete incremental patch, both new modules, all six new tests, README/TESTS/DESIGN-MATRIX, and the actual called Control/provider/journal/report boundaries against the approved `/private/tmp/kegari-independent-read-effect-membership-design-v1/DESIGN.md`.

## B1 — a rejected source Value is recorded as returned

`draft/src/worker.rs:2532–2540` calls the observer before `bounded_value(value)`. A valid UTF-8 file within the 48,000-byte source bound can expand beyond MAX_TOOL_BYTES under JSON escaping (for example 12,000 NUL bytes). The callback therefore records `BrokerSemantic::Source.returned_value_digest`, then the actual tool returns `tool_limit` without that Value. The call result error remains retained; this is contradictory observation semantics, not authority or no-effect evidence.

Obtain the successfully bounded Value first, then pass that exact Value and the same descriptor-read bytes to the callback. Preserve the existing no-follow/read/path checks and the same-read mutation regression. Add escaped-oversize data to the real filesystem component and assert the callback is never invoked on that refusal. Root independently identified this boundary and the author accepted it for a separate immutable correction.

## B2 — archive accepts internally consistent but externally contradictory broker identities

`draft/src/evaluation_reports.rs:221–233` validates role, operation/workspace, suite/fixture/trial and the instruction-manifest digest, but does not compare `independent_broker.context_digest` with `manifest.context_digest` or its tool digest with `report.tool_contract_digest`. `IndependentBrokerObservation::validate` at `worker_broker_observation.rs:354–374` only relates the optional authority identity to the broker DTO itself. Consequently changing both matching diagnostic context/tool fields to a different well-formed digest leaves all these checks satisfied despite a contradiction with the original manifest/report. The optional authority identity's permission digest and source revision similarly lack the manifest comparison already performed for the existing `independent_boundary` field.

Add narrow cross-field checks against those existing report/manifest facts; when authority is present, retain the same source/permission consistency conditions as the original boundary diagnostic. Data-only archive contradiction tests are sufficient for this validation boundary and must not construct an execution capability. This does not show a native authority bypass or a scorer pass: this slice has no Complete state and changes no scoring rule. Root and author have accepted this correction.

## No further material finding in the reviewed paths

- The actual call UUID is allocated once and retained in CallReceipt before `perform`; the collector observes that UUID and the original thread/turn/call/tool/argument digest. Exact replay keeps the original table; changed arguments mark conflict without replacing the original member.
- Journal anchors are constructed from the same timestamped value passed to the original protected write. The original kind/digest/length is retained before first reread; later verification does not adopt changed bytes. Returned result identity is captured before the fallible existing tool_finished append, while the ordinary call table remains pending on append failure.
- Feedback expectation uses the actual immutable command and ProviderBroker binding, including provider target/account/payload, then the original permit's admitted-work/owner/scope encoding. This matches the existing GithubComment normalization and Control reservation encoding. No additional transport is introduced. Only known original operation UUIDs are inspected; no receipt inventory is used to infer membership.
- The private inventory checks original permit digest and exact contract Arc. Final observation enters one Control permit gate, drops RuntimeState before the retained independent cache gate, and reads exact receipt files without reacquiring Control. Journal verification and snapshot persistence occur outside that gate. Ordinary validate_permit still delegates to the same original predicate and does not allocate an observed snapshot.
- Actual pending task/hold or missing receipt yields Unknown; local ACK remains AcknowledgedOnly. NotSent requires the matching actual Reconciled receipt. Source/context semantics are per-read observations. Pending claim references are explicitly not independently read signed claim contents and not human acceptance.
- The shared Arc budget covers timestamped optional protocol/broker values and retained mandatory-reference accounting. It does not purport to bound all mandatory journal traffic, envelopes, or separate transport reads. Optional writes reserve before writing and do not refund on failure; overflow/conflict severity does not regress. The actual same-read source callback and all existing source permission checks remain intact apart from B1's order.
- The opt-in is the existing private declared Independent trial route. Ordinary workers retain None, dispatch gates and idempotency semantics remain, the new report field is default-omitted, and the compatibility edits add assertions/defaults rather than remove existing assertions.

## Test evidence and remaining limits

The five unit tests cover actual protected Journal mutation-before-first-read/deletion, shared capacity and no-space-before-write refusal, ProviderBroker normalization with zero transport, real Control pending/Sent/local ACK/not-sent/lost-response states and identity substitutions, and actual filesystem same-read bytes/traversal refusal. The report test is descriptive unavailable-data archive/legacy/Complete-refusal coverage. Two grading-error tests and ordinary opt-out gain preservation assertions.

The matrix honestly defers collector-enabled cancellation, duplicate/changed-duplicate composition, actual effect-return then tool_finished write fault through final registered collection, a genuine declared independent worker positive, native remote comment readback, and signed pending-claim contents. No new test directly drives the full BrokerCapture member lifecycle. The shared-budget test named `...uncertain_write` does not inject an uncertain storage write; it proves shared reserve accounting/exhaustion and no write on an already exhausted budget. These limits should remain explicit and prevent stronger evidence claims; they do not justify a fabricated native capability or a broader unreviewed fixture.

This review used only read-only source/hash inspection plus this separate TEMP record. It did not execute tests, Cargo, the collector, a provider, process probe or native worker; it did not edit the held artifact or repository. The transport full2 failure evidence remains preserved and its collector remains ineligible/unexecuted.

# Independent broker v2 correction review

No remaining material finding in this bounded static rereview. Both accepted v1 diagnostic-correctness findings are addressed without widening authority or report qualification. No tests, Cargo, native workers, provider actions or collectors were executed; the seven new test functions remain authored/unrun evidence at this artifact.

## Exact inputs

Reviewed the complete four-file v2 patch, all changed tests, the actual source read/encoded bound and report validation callers, the internal broker identity validator, existing descriptive report fixture, README/TESTS and prior review. FILES SHA256 1023883b7c28383a07382b878f6ba08454b895ff5146d66a6a8b622d728c1c14; patch 63cfb7f97306966215367d3f784774b14ed2b7cd30d127a1cb4af0beed33e2c9; COMPOSED b1080fabf72173276edb598dfde618fe33b2a57a308e8a0c459a2afde06e596b. All four base/draft pairs match their manifests, all bases equal immutable v1 drafts, and all fifteen effective composition hashes match. The prior v1 review SHA256 remains 20d63bc1c387e3d1bb503cf5f3202c3dd8d24756202136b5dd959c2c572526e3.

## B1 resolved: actual successful returned source Value

worker.rs now calls unchanged bounded_value before invoking the observation callback, and returns that same accepted Value. Path canonicalization, exact read grants, no-follow source opening, hard-link refusal, 48,000-byte source bound and UTF-8 checks are unchanged. The callback still receives the actual descriptor-read bytes; it does not reread a mutable source path. A 20,000-NUL UTF-8 file fits the source bound but exceeds the 65,536-byte JSON Value bound after escaping; the new component negative requires exact tool_limit and no callback. Existing same-read mutation and traversal assertions are preserved. The correction makes successful-return evidence truthful; it does not establish transport delivery or remote effects.

## B2 resolved: external report identity consistency

validate_actual_report compares broker context_digest to the original InstructionManifest context and broker tool_contract_digest to the report's exact tool digest. With authority_at_collection present, it additionally compares source revision and permission digest against the actual manifest, matching the existing independent-boundary validation. The existing broker validator still binds its nested authority identity to operation/runtime/workspace, instruction/contract/context/tools/isolation. Report provenance and tool-definition checks remain in force afterward. No missing optional authority is promoted to success or execution authority.

The new archive test uses the existing explicitly synthetic report-reader fixture, declares a real manifest independent-review variant, and keeps its outcome Blocked with no grade. Each contradictory context/tool/source/permission case remains internally well shaped, then must be rejected as evaluation_record_conflict against archived facts. The consistent case remains Blocked. This is a meaningful archive consistency regression and is not a native capability or genuine execution positive.

## Evidence precision and limits

The budget test was only renamed to match what it actually proves: shared monotone accounting and refusal before a write when exhausted. It still does not inject an uncertain storage-write outcome; the README retains that limit. Existing v1 pending/ACK-only semantics, original membership and same-write anchors, private opt-in and no Complete state are unchanged. No scorer, suite, canary, authority constructor or fixture migration is introduced. Enabled-call cancellation, actual tool-finished write failure and a registered native positive remain explicit unproven cases from v1.

This rereview does not requalify the entire fifteen-file layer or its later transport-source3 merge. The original v1 review supplies the broader static boundary analysis; root owns compilation, tests and integration. INPUTS.json pins all reviewed artifacts and relevant effective source bytes.

limits: Actual local protected Journal/Control/ProviderBroker/source-reader components and descriptive archive fixtures only; no genuine registered native worker or actual-agent trial.

Only same-owner registered broker subset is described. Unknown/pending, ACK-only and missing claim content remain explicit; no Complete or universal read/effect/output inventory or canary non-disclosure.
No effects, report DTOs, callback returns or synthetic identity data reconstruct an execution, acceptance, release or cold authority capability.

Shared 8 MiB accounting bounds optional timestamped diagnostic records; it does not claim all mandatory worker journal I/O is so bounded. Cancelled enabled-call and actual finish-write-fault registered capture remain unexercised.
Scorers, fixtures, instructions and qualification predicates are unchanged. Seven new test names and compatibility results do not establish E07 behavioral qualification.
